name: Savoia Hotels
note: Two Bologna hotels (Savoia Hotel Regency and Savoia Hotel Country House). Back-of-shirt sponsor, sixth season of partnership with Virtus when announced in September 2025; the mark sits across the upper back of the 2026/27 home jerseys in the club store's product photos. Left unrated: the Savoia Hotels footer names Nonsolohotel Ltd. as exercising management and coordination, but no checked source names who owns Nonsolohotel Ltd.
